तक् तकति 1.
a. To laugh at or de-
ride; to bear. With व्यति to re-
tort a laugh. (इ) तङ्कति to live
in distress, or want.

तकिल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Fraudulent,
crafty.
f. A medicament.

तक्य (क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
a. Laughable, ri-
diculous; to be borne.

तक्र (क्रं) 1.
n. Butter-milk with a
fourth part of water.

तक्र-कूर्च्चिका (का) 1.
f. Inspissated
or thickened butter-milk.

तक्र-मांस (सं) 1.
n. Meat fried with
ghee and eaten with butter-milk.

तक्ष् तक्षति 1.
a. To cover; to peel.
(न, ऊ) तक्ष्णोति to pare; with
5.
a. सं To censure.

तक्षक (कः) 1.
m. A principal serpent
of
pātāla; a carpenter; a chief
actor in the prelude of a drama;
a tree;
Vishwakarma.

तक्षण (णं) 1.
n. Paring, peeling.
planing.
f. A carpenter's adze.

तक्ष-शिला (ला) 1.
f. The name of a
city;
Taxila in the
Punjab.
